ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What does a carnivore feed on?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a schematic diagram of a food web, including nodes such as Nekt(on), Carnivores, Interface Feeders, Filter Feeders, Grazers, Deep Deposit Feeders, Detritus/Bacteria, etc. The Carnivores node is located in the upper right part of the image, and the Interface Feeders node is located below Carnivores toward the middle. It can be seen that there is an arrow from Interface Feeders to Carnivores. Reasoning: The question asks what carnivore feed on, so according to the direction in which the food web arrows indicate the object being fed on to the feeder, the arrows pointing to Carnivores should be checked. Interface Feeders has an arrow pointing to Carnivores, indicating that carnivores consume/feed on interface feeders. So the answer is interface feeder.
